requirements.evidence: queues.blade.php:1-18 renders only the list plus '<!-- Create Modal Placeholder -->'. The create, detail, rename, toggle-confirmation and access modals are all missing. Queues.php:78 reads '$this->accessQueue', which is not a property, so every render fails. rename() (Queues.php:143) never passes a re-derived slug, and create() computes $slug (Queues.php:98) but never uses it. Serve.php:259 has '// Simplified: no access grants logic implemented.', so employees with grants get no queues. waitingTickets (Serve.php:281-286) does not filter by status or mode. serve.blade.php has no waiting list and no mode selector. The navbar is not changed. 'ui.serve_rate_limited' (Serve.php:304) is not defined in either lang file.

conventions.evidence: Domain writes do go through CreateQueue/UpdateQueue/SetQueueAccess/CallNextTicket. However, renameName has no #[Validate] even though Queues.php:140 calls validateOnly('renameName'). mode, selectedQueueId and lastCalledTicketId are neither validated nor locked. Helpers callableQueues()/waitingTickets() are public (Serve.php:249,271). No docs or CHANGELOG update. No Blade components were extracted.

security.evidence: Queues.php:69 calls authorize('create', Queue::class, $entity). The third argument is dropped, so the policy never receives the entity. No route-level authorization was added (web.php:499). confirmToggle($id) (Queues.php:153-157) assigns an unscoped client id to viewingQueueId. 'catch (Exception $e)' (Queues.php:104,148,170) swallows AuthorizationException into a form error. Serve.php:296-300 swallows the not-found for a foreign id instead of raising it. lastCalledTicketId is not #[Locked]. mode is unvalidated, so CallMode::from throws a ValueError. Scoped findOrFail is used for grant/revoke and openQueue.

tests.evidence: The diff contains no test files: no feature, unauthorized-call or tamper tests for Queues, Serve or the Members tabs.

simplicity.evidence: The code is short but leaves dead locals ('$slug' at Queues.php:98, '$queue' at :100). callableQueues() fetches the queues before checking membership. The try/catch around findOrFail exists only to swallow the exception (Serve.php:276-280).

readability.evidence: Unused imports: Log, RateLimiter, EntityMembership and User in Queues.php; Log, Queue, TicketStatus, EntityMembership and User in Serve.php. Dangling calls with empty trailing lines ('$this->name, \n \n );' at Queues.php:100-102 and :143-145). Placeholder comments in the view and the PHP. Inline FQCNs in routes (web.php:499-500). Files lack a final newline.

scope.evidence: All edits relate to the task. The extra lang keys ('queues_inactive', 'serve_title') support the new views.

issues.explanation: render() reads the undefined property $this->accessQueue on every render, so the component throws and the Queues page cannot load.
The create, detail, rename, toggle-confirmation and access modals are not implemented; the view contains only a placeholder comment.
No tests ship with the change, which violates the TDD rule and the Livewire definition of done (unauthorized-call and tamper tests).
authorize('create', Queue::class, $entity) drops the entity argument, so the policy cannot check the entity role correctly; the routes have no can middleware either.
rename() does not pass the slug re-derived from the new name, and renameName has no validation rule.
Employees with a call grant get no callable queues because grant logic is explicitly left out.
waitingTickets() ignores ticket status, mode and call authorization, and the view never renders the waiting list, channel labels or a mode selector.
A foreign selectedQueueId is swallowed into a notice instead of raising not-found; in Queues, catch (Exception) also swallows AuthorizationException from the actions.
confirmToggle($id) writes an unscoped client-supplied id into viewingQueueId instead of acting on the queue being viewed.
mode is not validated (CallMode::from can throw a ValueError) and lastCalledTicketId is not #[Locked], contrary to the contract and the Livewire policy.
The nav_queues and nav_serve links were not added to the navbar dropdown.
wire:click="selectedQueueId=..." is not a valid Livewire action (it should use $set), and the controls have no aria-labels.
ui.serve_rate_limited is used but not defined in either lang file.
The tabs use ul.tabs instead of the Bulma div.tabs > ul structure, and the tab links have no role=tab or aria attributes.
The helpers callableQueues() and waitingTickets() are public and therefore callable endpoints; they should be protected.
Unused imports, unused locals ($slug, $queue) and dangling empty argument lines.

review.summary: The change adds Queues and Serve components, routes, lang keys and a members tab bar, but most of the work is unfinished. The Queues page throws on every render because of the undefined $this->accessQueue, and none of its modals exist. Rename ignores the slug, Serve has no grant logic, waiting list or mode selector, and the navbar is unchanged. There are also several Livewire security gaps and no tests, so the change must be rejected.
